note: Provenance of the real data and the independent reference behind the gene-expression-analysis numerical check. The series matrix is committed as GEO served it; the platform record is committed reduced (what was removed is stated); the reference numbers are computed by base R, not by the platform's module.

series.title: Expression data from wild type versus HDAC knock out mouse embryonic stem cells
series.design: 3 wild-type and 3 HDAC1 knock-out mouse embryonic stem cell arrays, Affymetrix MG-U74Av2 (GPL81), MAS 5.0 processed linear intensities

platform.title: [MG_U74Av2] Affymetrix Murine Genome U74A Version 2 Array

fullRecord.why: 22.5 MB of text, mostly Gene Ontology strings and 6,909 sample ids of other series; the test needs only the probe-to-gene table

platform.reduction: gzip (mtime 0, level 9) of the record with the `!Platform_sample_id` and `!Platform_series_id` lines and the `#` column-description lines removed, and the table cut to six columns (ID, GB_ACC, Species Scientific Name, Gene Title, Gene Symbol, ENTREZ_GENE_ID); all 12,488 probe rows and every other `!Platform_` line kept as served

terms.statement: NCBI itself places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data contained therein; original submitters may claim patent, copyright or other intellectual property rights in their contributions, and NCBI is not in a position to assess such claims.
terms.recordOwnTerms: Neither the series matrix nor the platform record states a licence of its own. GEO's own disclaimer page (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/info/disclaimer.html) answered a programmatic read with a reCAPTCHA page and could not be read; the policy above is what was read.
terms.decision: The 217 KB series matrix is committed byte-identical and the reduced platform table beside it, cited by accession; nothing of either is presented as the platform's own work.

reference.method: readLines/read.delim of the matrix; GEO2R's log2 rule; base t.test (Welch, var.equal = FALSE) per probe; base p.adjust(method = "BH"); ordered by p value, then absolute t, then probe id
reference.independence: no code of the platform's module is used; R's t distribution functions are not scipy's
reference.tolerance: relative 1e-8 on mean, log2 fold change, t, df, p value, adjusted p value and interval lower bound; the order of the top 50 probes identical; counts exact (checked by runtime/mcp/evimed-research/test/test_gene_expression.py)
